about_the_game:
Hellbit is a roguelike about survival through movement and temptation.
You play as a small devil in the inferno who discovers the Mythic Sword — a living weapon that whispers, hungers, and seeks to rule Hell through you.

Your weapon swings on its own — all you control is where, when, and how you move.
Every dodge, every step, and every risk decides whether you live… or become the sword’s next host.

Each run drops you deeper into the inferno — procedurally generated arenas filled with waves of demons, traps, and brutal bosses.
There are no safe spots, no perfect patterns — only sharp reflexes, timing, and a blade that may not always obey.

The sword fights for you, but only if you feed its hunger.

Features

  • Automatic combat – Your cursed sword attacks on its own; your survival depends entirely on movement and positioning.

  • Procedural arenas – Each run brings new layouts, enemy waves, and infernal hazards.

  • Permadeath – Fall, and the sword simply finds another host. Learn patterns, adapt, and descend again.

  • Risky upgrades – Shrines, curses, and demonic blessings offer immense power at a deadly cost.

  • Boss encounters – Survive colossal demons that fill the screen with fire and chaos.
